title: The Eriksson Programme (Yang-Mills): Auditable Claim-to-Theorem Manifest, Certified Obstructions, and Continuation Frontier (Release yang-mills-archive-v1.0)
abstract: This archival technical note provides a self-contained, auditable claim-to-theorem specification and continuation handoff for the Yang-Mills Lean 4 formalization inside THE-ERIKSSON-PROGRAMME at archival release yang-mills-archive-v1.0 (commit 6b54eca695e96b3038ceda18276c4e28fb45983f; canonical Lean core checkpoint 02fae0ad, Lean v4.29.0-rc6, pinned mathlib 07642720480157414db592fa85b626dafb71355b). Responding to v1's assessments, this v2 revision replaces directory-level summaries with exact fully-qualified Lean 4 theorem statements, explicit coupling and geometric hypotheses, concrete strictly-interacting SU(2) non-vacuity witnesses (0 < |beta| <= 1e-5), exact operator classes and volume quantifiers for the certified obstructions (volume-uniform Poincare walls and flat Hodge factorized-penalty walls), a strict separation of YangMillsCore-compiled, oracle_check-audited, and standalone declarations, and resolved AIRR identifiers for all 32 indexed mathematical-physics records. No four-dimensional continuum limit, physical SU(N) OS/Wightman reconstruction, or Clay Millennium Prize solution is claimed; open formalization tasks (fixed-spacing Wilson reflection positivity and hRpoly in draft PR #29) are distinguished from open mathematics.

ai_assistance.statement: Large language models assisted manuscript preparation and Lean 4 formalization under author supervision. Core mathematical claims are verified by the Lean 4 kernel with standard axioms only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Independent frontier-model assessments are recorded separately in registry/model-assessments.json.

conflicts: The author owns and administers AIRR; no independent editorial admission is claimed.
editorial.statement: Working-paper version v2 supersedes v1. Declared major revision: Replaces directory-level prose with an auditable claim-to-theorem manifest containing exact Lean 4 signatures, explicit coupling/domain hypotheses, non-vacuity witnesses, obstruction operator classes, and resolved AIRR cross-references. It remains outside the AIRR accepted collection until this exact version passes review and receives a human decision.

technical_note.scope_statement: Auditable claim-to-theorem archival specification and continuation handoff for THE-ERIKSSON-PROGRAMME release yang-mills-archive-v1.0, quoting exact Lean 4 signatures, explicit coupling/domain hypotheses, strictly-interacting non-vacuity witnesses, exact obstruction classes, and all 32 live AIRR identifiers.
technical_note.limitations: This technical note proves no new theorem beyond synthesizing and auditing the verified Lean 4 core and companion records. It explicitly claims no 4D continuum limit (a -> 0), no physical SU(N) Osterwalder-Schrader or Wightman reconstruction, and no Clay Millennium Mass Gap solution; standalone R1/R2 cylinder modules and draft PR #29 remain outside YangMillsCore.
